♎ The Libra Cloth. [OFFENSE/DEFENSE]

Cloth Passive — The Cloth of Arms

The only Gold Cloth that carries weapons. You are trained in martial weapons, and they advance with your unarmed proficiency automatically.

Your Cloth contains six weapon pairs — twin swords, tridents, nunchaku, shields, sanjiegun, and tonfa. You summon or dismiss any of them as a free action, they can never be disarmed or destroyed, and they accept weapon runes.

Techniques

  • 1st — Signature (L1) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Rozan Shō Ryū Ha]
  • 2nd (L6) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.The Twelve Arms]
  • 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Rozan Ryū Hi Shō]
  • 4th — Ultimate (L16) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Athena's Arsenal: Overdrive]

Ascendant Boon — The Balance [OFFENSE/DEFENSE]

Wield any two Libra weapons regardless of the hands they normally require.

They count as +1 fundamental rune tier (to the game's cap). You gain a +2 status bonus to all saves, and the first natural 1 you roll each hour counts as a 10.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Libra)]

Zenith Boon — The Balance (Zenith) [OFFENSE/DEFENSE]

As the Ascendant Boon, plus Rozan Hyaku Ryū Ha once per round ◆◆◆: 60-foot line, @Damage[12d10[bludgeoning]] damage, basic Reflex; a critical failure also knocks the target prone and stuns it 2.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Libra)]
